data.text: **Question:** How does the JIT compiler work in .NET?
JIT compiles IL code to native machine code at runtime. Methods are compiled on first call. NGen and AOT provide alternatives for faster startup.
JIT converts Intermediate Language to native code. Compiles methods on first invocation. Optimizes based on runtime information. Tiered compilation recompiles hot paths with more optimizations.
